authorization: Simone, 14 November 2026: add fixed-reference comparison to existing paper monitoring, Monitor and weekly review; no alerts or live changes.
population: Existing active Most Aces Count (primary) and Direct current-input (secondary) forecasts, unchanged eligibility. One first complete paired pre-match decision per OnCourt tournament edition/round/player IDs; date changes cannot create another bet. No past replay backfill.
input_policy: Known first observations and quote timestamps <= now; current hash-bound receipt for all configured bookmakers; complete exact-market vectors; verified current OnCourt player IDs/edition/round; common exact kickoff. Existing confidence exclusions retained. No-bets retained on the same paired cohort.
reference: Median per outcome of complete same-book no-vig vectors, renormalized; at least two distinct quality-valid books. Reference fixed at capture for all execution books. Best fresh same-contract price; existing maximum EV outcome rule unchanged.
outcomes: Use existing exact result index, pin tournament ID, round ID and both full names. Original decision immutable; actual result date and hash saved separately. Existing bookmaker retirement/void rules; ambiguous results held, never losses.
primary_metric: Count paired P/L difference per independently settled common opportunity; 0 for no-bets. Meaningful difference 0.02u per opportunity. Full-cohort probability scores identical by construction; reference calibration and selected-subset scores descriptive.
uncertainty: Review 50 and100 independently settled fixtures. At least30 changed settled decisions across10 editions before any economic conclusion; this is a minimum feasibility condition, not proof of adequate precision. Cluster by edition; suppress CI with fewer10 editions. No automatic promotion.
seen_evidence: All through14 November exploratory replay excluded from forward ledger; exact-start research Count5settled common fixtures, zero changed bets. Direct4common settled, one added loss.
baseline: Current best-EV-then-own-book20pp gate, unchanged model p and non-gap rules; paired replay is distinct from issued alert or source-row ledger.
reporting: Existing private Monitor, profit graphs and scheduled weekly report only. Zero new notifications/schedules/deployments.
